title: Audit repeat detected
description: A source's sequence repeated, or went back, under a new event ID during ingestion (contracts, section 8.4; AUD-02). The event itself is decided as any other.

source.description: The event source whose sequence repeated or went back.

last_seq.description: The highest sequence number that the source had reached.

received_seq.description: The sequence number received, at most last_seq.

event_id.description: The ID of the event that repeated a position, new to its source.

instance_id.description: The module instance that published the batch, if known.
